title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Status Schedule: Qualification Thresholds and Status Periods
content:
Each Ashbury Rewards tier is reached with elite night credits earned in one calendar year and, for the top tier only, with qualifying spend in that same calendar year as well. Once reached, a tier is guaranteed for a fixed period, and a member who does not requalify falls no lower than the floor tier listed for the tier held.

## Schedule by tier

| Tier | Elite night credits needed in one calendar year | Qualifying spend needed in the same calendar year (USD) | Calendar years after the year of qualification at whose end of February the tier stops being guaranteed | Month whose last day closes the guaranteed period | Lowest tier at the annual reassessment without requalification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 (February) | Ashbury Rewards Member |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 10 | 0 | 2 | 2 (February) | Ashbury Rewards Member |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 25 | 0 | 2 | 2 (February) | Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 50 | 0 | 2 | 2 (February) | Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 75 | 0 | 2 | 2 (February) | Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 100 | 23000 | 2 | 2 (February) | Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite |

Elite night credits restart from zero on **January 1** of every year, for every tier.

## Notes to the schedule

1. A qualifying spend of 0 means that the tier is reached on night credits alone. Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite is the only tier that needs both thresholds: 100 elite night credits and 23000 US dollars of qualifying spend, both in the same calendar year.
2. The base tier, Ashbury Rewards Member, has no guaranteed period (0 years) and is its own floor.
3. The floor applies to the tier held at the reassessment. A member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite who did not requalify falls no lower than Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite. A member at Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite who did not requalify can fall to Ashbury Rewards Member.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A member who reaches Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite during the hypothetical year 2025 holds a tier guaranteed for 2 calendar years after 2025, so the guarantee runs to the last day of February (month 2) of 2027.

| Night credits in the year (hypothetical) | Qualifying spend in the same year (hypothetical) | Highest tier whose thresholds are met |
|---|---|---|
| 49 | any | Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite |
| 50 | any | Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite |
| 100 | 22999.99 USD | Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite |
| 100 | 23000.00 USD | Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite |
